_what: Which telemetry sinks may receive anything about a page or event, read by the one gate src/telemetry-gate.mjs. The decision comes from the privacy class of the data being served, never from the sink. A class is a row: `rank` orders them from least to most private (when two sources name a class, the more private one wins), and `sinks` lists the sinks it may feed. A surface and path that match no `routes` row, and a declared class that is not a row here, are `unknown_class`, which feeds no sink: not known yet means private. `header` is the response header a handler sets to declare the class of the page it served. `sinks` lists each sink and who reads it.

sinks.label: The page script is added to a served page
Visits, clicks and scrolls a page sends
Closed-category client errors and slow loads
Steps the Worker itself saw (tool runs, checkout, sign-up)

classes.label: Another person's or a customer's records
Not known yet, so treated as private
